---
title: Risotto with eel
id: MAR-0101
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 60
difficulty: medium
---
## Ingredients
- 280 g Italian rice
- 1.5 l court-bouillon
- 1 sea bass of 600 g ready for cooking
- 20 g butter
- 30 g sour butter
- 2 shallots
- to taste salt
## Method
1. Put the court-bouillon and the sea bass in a fish kettle.
2. Cook for about 10 minutes from the moment of boiling, then drain the sea bass and fillet it; put the bone with the head and all discarded parts into the cooking water and cook them for 20 minutes.
3. Peel and slice the shallots, let them wilt in a pan with half the butter, after 5 minutes add the sea bass flesh and let it flavor for 3-4 minutes.
4. Melt the remaining butter and toast the rice in it for a minute.
5. Pour the boiling broth obtained, one ladle at a time, so that the liquid just covers the surface of the rice, and bring to cooking.
6. Stir, turn off the heat, add the sea bass, mantecate with the sour butter and serve.
7. Risotto with eel
